integrity_statement: Analytical proof and deterministic reproducibility code; finite checks are not a proof. Full source-formula provenance is credited. Scientific comparison and self-review do not establish independent originality or validation.
scientific_limitations: Equal-rate, one-dimensional Brownian chain started at the origin; only the tagged particle marginal, not joint mixing. Large-index asymptotics assume fixed positive diffusivity and reset rate. Existing exact transient densities are prior art; the global TV profile and critical coefficient are mathematical deductions that may be implicit in more general variance-mixture results.
title: Total-variation relaxation profile and Gaussian critical layer in nested stochastic resetting
